name: io.github.tobyandrews1985/basketeer
description: Personal Tesco grocery account (UK, CZ) over MCP: search, basket, slots, orders, and nutrition.

environmentVariables.name: TESCO_MARKET
environmentVariables.description: Tesco storefront: uk (default), or cz (experimental, community-maintained)

environmentVariables.name: TESCO_MARKET_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a custom market JSON file, instead of TESCO_MARKET (untested, no guarantees)

environmentVariables.name: TESCO_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Session renewal: browser (default) or http (browserless; Czech storefront)
